message.content: An illustration on a magazine cover features a central figure from the chest up, facing forward. The figure is a light-skinned person wearing a white, patterned skullcap and a white, buttoned garment. They hold a pair of black binoculars up to their eyes with both hands. The figure’s skin is detailed with shadows and lines. Reflections are visible in the binocular lenses: the left lens shows a plume of dark smoke rising into the air, and the right lens shows the barrel of a firearm pointed downward. Large red letters at the top read "TEMPO". Smaller text above this reads "LAPORAN KHUSUS 200 TAHUN LETUSAN TAMBORA". Below the "TEMPO" logo, it says "30 MARET-5 APRIL 2015". Superimposed on the figure's chest is bold black text: "JALUR REKRUTMEN ANGGOTA ISIS". Below this is smaller text: "PENELUSURAN TEMPO HINGGA PERBATASAN TURKI-SURIAH." At the bottom left, there is a barcode, the price "RP 39.500", and other publishing details. The background is a solid dark purple.
